# SMAA

[SMAA](https://github.com/iryoku/smaa) by Jimenez, Echevarria, Masia, Navarro and Gutierrez, MIT licence
(`LICENSE.txt`). Files from commit `71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d`, unmodified: `SMAA.hlsl`,
`Textures/AreaTex.h` and `Textures/SearchTex.h` (here without the folder). `SMAAShader.h` holds `SMAA.hlsl`
as a raw string for `runtime/gpu/d3d12.cpp`, which compiles it with `SMAA_CUSTOM_SL`.
